title: Automated microbial recognition from gram-stained micrographs via CNN and metadata decision support.
summary: A CNN trained on 2,034 gram-stained micrographs covering 33 species linked its predictions to microbiological metadata; on an independent test set, accuracy, weighted F1 and MCC were all 0.84, with perfect precision and recall for the most distinctive taxa. No prospective external cohort was evaluated.
